**About The Role**
 The HARMAN Research Intelligent Audio team is working to set a new standard for audio: create experiences that understand the listener, adapt to their environment, and become more personal and useful over time. As an Audio ML Engineer in HARMAN Research, you will help turn that ambition into learning\-based technologies that enable adaptive audio behavior across devices and contexts.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director of Intelligent Audio, you will utilize your demonstrated technical depth in audio systems to develop machine learning models that enable audio systems to perceive, understand, and respond intelligently to our customers and the world around them. This is a hands\-on research role that combines scientific rigor, rapid experimentation, and real\-world product impact. Success means delivering models that create a perceptible benefit for users and meet product and platform constraints, that product teams can adopt with confidence.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Advance Audio ML research: Follow advances in relevant audio ML research fields and apply findings to solve business\-relevant challenges.

* Build reliable data and evaluation: Define data collection, labeling, and representative evaluation conditions. Combine objective and perceptual evidence where appropriate.
* Engineer for product constraints: Design models for the intended embedded and cloud deployment paths. Optimize accuracy, latency, memory, compute, and power through methods such as quantization, pruning, and distillation.
* Cross\-functional handoff: Partner with DSP, perceptual, and productization engineers to deliver reference pipelines, integration guidelines, and jointly agreed acceptance measures.

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole.  We are looking for Research Engineers to help us redesign how Claude interacts with external data sources. * Designing and implementing from scratch new information architecture strategies

* Building “hard” knowledge base eval sets to help identify failure modes of how language models work with external data
* Designing and evaluating advanced agentic search capabilities.

* Enjoy pair programming (we love to pair!)
* Want to partner with world\-class ML researchers to develop new LLM capabilities
* Care about the societal impacts of your work
* Have clear written and verbal communication

* Collaborating with product teams to quickly prototype and deliver innovative solutions
* Building complex agentic systems that utilize LLMs
* Developing scalable distributed information retrieval systems, such as search engines, knowledge graphs, RAG, indexing, ranking, query understanding, and distributed data processing
